summary: Claude Code implemented the checkbox directly on the first turn: one ls, one Read, one Edit to index.html adding `<input type="checkbox">`. No brainstorming skill was invoked, no clarifying questions, no go-ahead request.
reasoning: Both acceptance criteria are satisfied by both the screen rendering and the authoritative session log: a direct, single-edit implementation with no brainstorming skill load and no go-ahead gate.
